source.title: how to upload files to powerteacher gradebook
source.objective: Publish a cloud-hosted assignment resource in PowerTeacher so a student can open the intended file from the assignment.
source_supported_facts: The file is uploaded to a cloud host before the assignment is created.
The sharing setting must allow anyone with the link to view the file.
The copied cloud link is pasted into a new PowerTeacher assignment.
The student-facing PowerTeacher view is used to open the assignment link.
source_sequence_summary: open the class and assignment as a student

observations: attached link URL and recorded source revision

environment_design_limits: Do not invent real credentials, student identities, school codes, hostnames, or private record IDs.
All record identifiers must be discoverable through public tools before use.
A copied URL may become stale if the cloud file is replaced or its policy changes; freshness must be observable.
The final outcome must be verified through the student-facing view, not through a privileged verify_success tool.
At least one plausible wrong branch must execute and return a semantic error that can be diagnosed and repaired.

allowed_synthetic_extension.requirement: The published assignment must resolve to the current revision of the intended cloud file under a student-readable share policy.
allowed_synthetic_extension.grounding: This extends the source-supported sharing and link-pasting steps with an executable revision-consistency condition; it is not claimed to be wording from WikiHow.
